sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Reservations"."Room" AS e, SUM("Reservations"."Kids") AS m1, AVG("Reservations"."Adults") AS m2, (CAST(AVG("Reservations"."Adults") AS REAL) / SUM("Reservations"."Kids")) AS m3 FROM "Reservations" GROUP BY "Reservations"."Room") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"

average of number of adults per Rooms (by Room)
